# Uday Sheth

## About

Uday Sheth is a developer and creator with a background spanning software development, digital media, design, and marketing.

He builds web applications, browser extensions, automation tools, and other software projects, while also working in social media and digital content.

He holds a BCA and MCA degrees and maintains a portfolio of personal and open-source projects.

## Projects

### Ghost Clean

- **Page:** https://udaysheth.netlify.app/projects/ghost-clean.html
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Sheth007/Ghost-Clean
- **Firefox Add-on:** https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/ghost-clean/
- **Type:** Firefox browser extension
- **Status:** Published

Ghost Clean is a privacy-focused Firefox extension for managing and cleaning browser data.

Features include:

- Browser-wide data cleanup
- Site-specific data cleanup
- Cookie whitelist
- Scheduled cleanup
- Startup cleanup
- History, cookies, cache, downloads, local storage, and IndexedDB cleanup
- Local cleanup statistics
- Dashboard for browser-data management

The extension is built using Firefox WebExtensions APIs and uses local extension storage for user settings and cleanup statistics.

It is designed to keep managed browsing data on the user's device and does not send browsing history, cookies, saved passwords, page contents, or other browsing activity to external telemetry services.


### Flutter Recon

- **Page:** https://udaysheth.netlify.app/projects/flutter-recon.html
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Sheth007/flutter-recon
- **Type:** Browser extension
- **Status:** Open source

Flutter Recon is a browser extension for detecting Flutter-powered websites and identifying publicly exposed Flutter and Dart package references.

The extension:

- Detects Flutter web runtime signatures
- Inspects publicly available page assets and bundle information
- Identifies referenced Flutter and Dart packages
- Presents discovered packages in a browser interface
- Links packages to their pages on pub.dev

The project is intended for developer research, technology exploration, and understanding how Flutter-based websites are implemented.


### E-Commerce Price Scraper

- **Page:** https://udaysheth.netlify.app/projects/price-scraper.html
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Sheth007/ECommerce-Price-Scraper
- **Type:** Python scraping and price comparison tool
- **Status:** Open source

E-Commerce Price Scraper collects product listings and prices from supported e-commerce websites and presents results for comparison.

The project provides:

- Graphical desktop interface
- Command-line interface
- Flask web interface
- Product search
- Multi-site price comparison
- HTML parsing with BeautifulSoup
- Browser automation where required

The project is built in Python and uses Flask, BeautifulSoup, and browser automation technologies.


### Data Harvester

- **Page:** https://udaysheth.netlify.app/projects/data-harvester.html
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Sheth007/data-harvester
- **Type:** OSINT research guide
- **Status:** Open source

Data Harvester is an educational guide for researching publicly available information through a structured OSINT workflow.

The project focuses on:

- Public information research
- Digital footprint research
- Cross-referencing public sources
- Source verification
- Structured investigation methodology

The guide is intended for legitimate and educational research using publicly accessible information.


### Indie Vibes

- **Page:** https://udaysheth.netlify.app/projects/indie-vibes.html
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Sheth007/indie-vibes
- **Type:** Full-stack music streaming web application
- **Status:** Open source

Indie Vibes is a PHP/MySQL music streaming application with user accounts, artist browsing, track playback, playlists, downloads, and user feedback.

The project includes:

- User registration and accounts
- Artist and track browsing
- Music playback
- Random playlist generation
- Persistent playback controls
- Track downloads
- User feedback

Technology used includes PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
